findings.claim: Line 30: "done_when: gpu-q refuses, with a non-zero exit and before taking the lock, a locked command whose argv is a bare `cargo test` / `cargo build` / `cargo nextest run` without a prior `--no-run` build." FT-1 is owner-free and falsifiable, baseline is measured (#3986, 1.5 min compile in 25 min suite), but proof only tests gpu-q and omits in-repo bare-flock wrappers (scripts/gpu_exclusive_run.sh, apr_locked).
findings.fix: Extend first-green proof and enforcement to cover repo-level wrappers (scripts/gpu_test.sh, apr_locked, gpu_exclusive_run.sh) in addition to gpu-q.

findings.claim: Line 40: "done_when: `scripts/gpu_lock_idle_sample.sh` samples utilization at 1 Hz while the lock is held, and writes `{host, window, samples, idle_fraction, holders[]}`." FT-2 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is cited (#3986 97% hand measurement), and first-green proof tests fake nvidia-smi series and non-zero exit on 0-sample windows.

Line 49: "done_when: `scripts/model_ladder.sh`'s CPU legs (`--no-gpu`, `-ngl 0 -dev none`) and its sha256 pass run without `apr_locked`/gpu-q." FT-3 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is cited (#3986 P3), and first-green proof asserts concurrency with sibling lock holder and mutant failure.

Lines 69-71: "the pre-freeze stage's receipt names the pre-screen host, its `compute_cap`, and the binary sha; the stage refuses when the pre-screen card's compute capability differs from the release host's; the stage refuses when the binary sha differs." FT-4 proof is partially vacuous: it validates receipt metadata and rejection on mismatched arch, but fails to assert that risk cells actually execute or that pre-screen REDs trigger required host reproduction before ticketing.
findings.fix: Add test assertions to FT-4 proof verifying risk cells are executed and included in the receipt, and that pre-screen RED triggers the reproduction requirement.

findings.claim: Line 76: "the ladder sweep partitions its cells across the hosts that can run them, and one reducer merges the shards into ONE receipt per release host." FT-5 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is cited (single host serial sweep), and proof tests rejection of missing shards, duplicates, and arch mismatches.

Line 89: "On yoga, a known-green model run executes concurrently with a CUDA correctness suite as separate processes (NOT MPS: an MPS client fault can kill the others)." FT-6 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is cited (binary mutex), and proof tests output sha256 equivalence and planted perturbation failure. However, it is an out-of-scope pilot for a speed release that changes no lock policy.
findings.fix: Defer FT-6 pilot to 0.71/0.72 or classify explicitly as non-blocking research for 0.70.

findings.claim: Line 103: "(b) the serve probe keeps its own evidence (#3949, already merged; this row is its regression guard staying wired)" FT-7 defines done_when for (a), (b), and (c), but lines 108-112 provide first-green proofs only for (a) and (c), completely omitting a proof for (b).
findings.fix: Add a specific first-green proof / regression test asserting serve probe evidence persistence for FT-7(b).

findings.claim: Line 115: "done_when: every integration-test target is compiled by some CI job, or deleted." FT-8 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is measured at origin/main 49fe19c28 (28 targets, 96/36 required-features), and proof uses check_test_targets_compiled.sh census with shrink-only baseline.

Lines 132-134: "(a) a guard simulates the publish cascade's drain over the current `cargo metadata` graph and requires completion; `TIERS[]` is corrected to the real order: 0 strictly-later-tier edges, from 44. (b) #3974: each of the release surface's verdict lines is classified, and every line is closed." FT-9 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is measured (cab272e5d, 44 edges, 58 dogfood lines at 49fe19c28), and proof tests planted cycle and verdict shrink-only ratchet.

Line 147: "the train ledger records `freeze_at` (the release branch cut) and `published_at` (crates.io + the GH release, the later of the two) from the automation. `scripts/check_release_train_duration.sh` computes X1 and fails a > 4 h release in the post-publish stage." FT-10 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is honestly unrecorded [U] for 0.69.0, and proof tests 4h01m failure and missing timestamp failure.

Line 156: "all open at 0.69.1's freeze (13:00Z 2026-09-23). Which of them land in 0.69.1 is settled by 0.69.1's own receipt. This row carries only what 0.69.1 did not close." FT-11 is owner-free, falsifiable, baseline is cited, but carrying low-bit and MoE bug fixes into 0.70 risks 4h train budget; #3951 oracle should stay in 0.70 while unclosed kernel bugs defer to 0.71.
findings.fix: Scope FT-11 in 0.70 strictly to #3951 oracle attribution; defer #3987, #3963, #3953, #3960 to 0.71 if not closed by 0.69.1.

findings.claim: Lines 160, 162-165: Line 160 specifies "Pillars: A coverage, B pv depth, C ONT-001 rows bound, D backlog", but lines 162-165 only provide baselines for A, C, and D, completely omitting Pillar B (pv depth). In addition, line 167 marks 0.70 thresholds as [U] pending aprender-cb sizing.
findings.fix: Add baseline measurement for Pillar B (pv depth) to lines 162-165 and populate concrete numerical 0.70 thresholds for Pillars A-D once sized.
